findings.body:
The hunk removes the closing `}` of `add` (old line 3). The head file ends at line 2 with `    a + b` and no closing brace, so the function body is unterminated and the crate fails to parse.

Trigger: Any build of the crate (cargo build or cargo test) after this change.

Impact: src/lib.rs does not compile, so the crate and any build or test depending on it fail.
findings.suggestion: Restore the closing brace: add a line `}` after `    a + b`.
findings.title: Closing brace of add() removed, leaving unterminated function

risk_level.reason: The diff touches only src/lib.rs with a tiny change to a simple add function, though the removed closing brace suggests a possible syntax error worth checking.
